(event EventBeginPlay
  (CallFunction|ApplyScaling)
  (if (Networking|HasAuthority)
    (CallFunction|UpdateTarget)
    (Utilities|Time|SetTimerbyFunctionName self "UpdateTarget" (Variables|Ghost|GetRetargetInterval) true)))

(event EventTick (DeltaSeconds)
  (bind _returnvalue (Transformation|GetActorLocation))
  (bind _target (Variables|Default|GetTarget))
  (bind _returnvalue_1 (Transformation|GetActorLocation _target))
  (bind _returnvalue_2 (Math|Vector|vector-vector _returnvalue_1 _returnvalue))
  (bind _returnvalue_3 (Math|Vector|Normalize _returnvalue_2))
  (bind _returnvalue_4 (Utilities|Time|GetGameTimeInSeconds))
  (Transformation|SetRelativeLocation (Variables|Default|GetGhostMesh) (Math|Vector|MakeVector 0.0 0.0 (+ (Variables|Ghost|GetMeshBaseZ) (* (Variables|Ghost|GetBobHeight) (Math|Trig|Sin(Radians) (* _returnvalue_4 (Variables|Ghost|GetBobSpeed)))))))
  (if (Networking|HasAuthority)
    (Utilities|IsValid _target
      (:"Is Valid"
        (if (< _returnvalue_4 (Variables|Default|GetBackoffUntil))
          (Transformation|SetActorLocation (Math|Vector|vector-vector _returnvalue (Math|Vector|vector*vector _returnvalue_3 (Math|Vector|vector*vector (* (Variables|Ghost|GetGhostSpeed) DeltaSeconds) (Variables|Ghost|GetBackoffSpeedMultiplier)))))
          (elif (> (Math|Vector|VectorLength _returnvalue_2) 50.0)
            (Transformation|SetActorLocation (Math|Vector|vector+vector _returnvalue (Math|Vector|vector*vector _returnvalue_3 (Math|Vector|vector*vector (Variables|Ghost|GetGhostSpeed) DeltaSeconds))))))
        (Transformation|SetActorRotation (Math|Rotator|MakeRotator 0.0 0.0 (.yaw (Math|Rotator|FindLookAtRotation _returnvalue _returnvalue_1))))))))

(event Collision|EventActorBeginOverlap (OtherActor)
  (bind _returnvalue (Utilities|Time|GetGameTimeInSeconds))
  (if (Networking|HasAuthority)
    (bind _aspawn (Utilities|Casting|CastToPawn OtherActor))
    (if (and (Pawn|IsPlayerControlled _aspawn) (>= _returnvalue (Variables|Default|GetBackoffUntil)))
      (Game|Damage|ApplyDamage _aspawn (Variables|Ghost|GetGhostDamage) 0 self)
      (Variables|Default|SetBackoffUntil (+ _returnvalue (Variables|Ghost|GetBackoffDuration)))
      (if (|GetbDebugLog)
        (Development|PrintString (Utilities|String|Append "Ghost touched " (Utilities|GetObjectName _aspawn)) false)))))
